import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load dataset
data = {
    "Person ID": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "Gender": ["Male", "Male", "Male", "Male", "Male"],
    "Age": [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    "Occupation": ["Software Engineer", "Doctor", "Doctor", "Sales Representative", "Sales Representative"],
    "Sleep Duration": [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    "Quality of Sleep": [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    "Physical Activity Level": [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    "Stress Level": [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    "BMI Category": ["Overweight", "Normal", "Normal", "Obese", "Obese"],
    "Blood Pressure": [126/83, 125/80, 125/80, 140/90, 140/90],
    "Heart Rate": [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    "Daily Steps": [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    "Sleep Disorder": ["", "", "Sleep Apnea", "Sleep Apnea", "Sleep Apnea"]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert blood pressure to numeric
df['Blood Pressure'] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.extract('(\d+)').astype(int)

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 8))

# Plot sleep duration vs quality of sleep
sns.scatterplot(x="Sleep Duration", y="Quality of Sleep", data=df, ax=ax[0, 0])
ax[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep')

# Plot daily steps vs heart rate
sns.scatterplot(x="Daily Steps", y="Heart Rate", data=df, ax=ax[0, 1])
ax[0, 1].set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate')

# Plot stress level vs blood pressure
sns.scatterplot(x="Stress Level", y="Blood Pressure", data=df, ax=ax[1, 0])
ax[1, 0].set_title('Stress Level vs Blood Pressure')

# Plot BMI category vs age
sns.countplot(x="BMI Category", data=df, ax=ax[1, 1])
ax[1, 1].set_title('BMI Category vs Age')

# Layout so plots do not overlap
fig.tight_layout()
